visibility_contracts.hidden_secrets: 72 authored hidden rewards use native discovery/proximity/lock state; display must only consume World.objects() and never reveal all scene.objects secrets.
visibility_contracts.frontier: Only survey at stage0, apparatus at stage1 and worksite patrol at stage2 are interactive; repaired apparatus may remain scenery.
visibility_contracts.physical_lore: Sources vanish after taking; installed devices persist; reward appears only after native completion; carried/dropped state remains authoritative.
visibility_contracts.runtime: Life, network, affordance, trail-stable, trail-refuge, relic and encore-note objects are generated at runtime and cannot be audited from scene.objects alone.

baseline_5_30_gaps: 24 investigation riddle controls omitted from physical controller eligibility.
Dynamic network, combat-relic, trail-stable and nonresident life objects lacked 3D representation.
Living Atlas and Ground Forge sample state was not rendered in Adventure3D.
Four investigation state machines needed their own visible partial-state consequences.
limits: Runtime catalogue uses chapter24 at authored arrival with native mission flags unset; it is not a walkthrough of all availability states.
Scene and object counts do not establish art quality or legibility. Browser review is recorded separately.
The base campaign renderer covers all prepared scenes; the separate Remembering Cistern has its own renderer/model.
